grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 44721 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so every row is a distinct event with no exact duplicates to absorb. No single column is unique on its own (invoice_id distinct_count 2330 and stock_code distinct_count 3141 are both far below row_count 44721), so a derived identity over invoice_id, stock_code, and invoiced_at is used to identify each invoice line at the minute it was recorded; because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 this tuple is expected to be unique per row and the grain stays transaction rather than aggregated.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice header identifier such as '489434' with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330, grouping multiple line items under one invoice.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Boolean flag with distinct_values [false, true] and null_rate 0.0 marking whether the line represents a cancellation rather than a normal sale.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code such as '10002' or '10123C' with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141, identifying the item on the line.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND' with null_rate 0.005098, nullable because some stock codes lack a recorded description.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units transacted on the line ranging from -1395 to 5184 with null_rate 0.0; negative samples indicate returns or cancellations, and this value is summed across lines.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice line ranging from 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with null_rate 0.0, resolving to whole minutes with seconds always at :00.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Per-unit price ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0, compared and multiplied against quantity to derive line value.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier such as 12346 with null_rate 0.300664, nullable because roughly 30 percent of lines lack a captured customer; it labels the buyer rather than measuring anything.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country such as 'Australia' or 'Germany' with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 24, describing the shipping or billing locale of the line.

category_description: Each row is one line item on a customer invoice, capturing the product, quantity, unit price, and timestamp of that line as recorded in the silver invoice lines table.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, identifying its time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that consumes this contract to emit gold models.
usage: The mapping contract rendered from this proposal is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed by a human before the modeling engine uses it to generate gold fact and dimension models from silver.silver_invoice_lines.
limitations: This mapping does not filter or exclude cancellation lines despite is_cancellation and negative quantity samples indicating returns, does not resolve the 30.0664 percent of rows with missing customer_id, and does not compute any derived business metrics beyond the declared line_identity grain key; such decisions are left to downstream consumers of the gold model.
